method: Alpamayo-supported sliding-window inference over a continuous 10-second segment
model_input_per_window: 1.6 s ego history plus the latest 4 frames from each of 4 cameras
prediction_per_window: 6.4 s future trajectory plus Chain-of-Causation text
visualization: Camera-calibrated projection on the front-wide image
corridor_note: The blue driving corridor is derived from the model-predicted center trajectory; it is not a separately predicted lane-boundary segmentation.

windows.chain_of_causation: Accelerate to proceed through the intersection since the straight traffic light is green
Keep distance to the lead vehicle since it is directly ahead in our lane

Change to the left lane and accelerate to merge into through traffic because the curbside right lane tapers/ends after the turn, while following the lead vehicle and clearing nearby cyclists/pedestrians at the corner; then match speed with main-road traffic after merging.
Keep distance to the lead vehicle since it is directly ahead in our lane after the right turn
Change lane to the left due to slower lead vehicle in the right lane and an available gap in the left lane, then match speed with left-lane traffic after merging.
